generations.prompt_sent: subject: A cinematic full-screen Webex MCP Server orchestration infographic using the same supplied reference composition, with one stable central cyan-and-teal MCP hub and exactly six clean unlabeled outcome nodes representing Customer notifications through Messages, Incident response through Rooms and Memberships, Account collaboration through Teams and Spaces, Access governance through People and Memberships, Event automation through Webhooks and Events, and Knowledge and approvals through ECM, Room Tabs, and Attachment Actions; all critical labels will be added later as verified vector overlays, so every generated frame contains no letters, words, numbers, captions, pseudo-code, glyph-like fragments, logos, fake product UI, or watermark; action: From zero to eight-tenths seconds a cyan inbound pulse enters the central hub; from eight-tenths to four-and-eight-tenths seconds the six outcome nodes activate one at a time in clockwise narration order with coherent connector flows and restrained success glows; from four-and-eight-tenths to six seconds the complete six-node system holds steadily; from six to seven-and-a-half seconds the camera gently pulls back until the system occupies about fifty-five percent of frame width while remaining centered against the same uninterrupted navy canvas; from seven-and-a-half to eight seconds hold that clean portal-sized composition with all icons, node positions, colors, connector routing, and lighting stable and with no corridor, walls, panels, doors, dashboard, topology change, flicker, duplication, malformed icon, unexplained particle, or generated text; scene: One uninterrupted deep navy spatial canvas derived from the repository’s webex-mcp-business-outcomes information architecture, with generous safe margins, a subtle technical grid, crisp geometric icons for notification, incident, account team, access shield, event flow, and enterprise knowledge approval, consistent spacing, and open areas reserved for post-production typography; the background remains a flat open navy field throughout and never becomes a room, tunnel, corridor, interface wall, or control panel; style: Premium enterprise editorial motion graphic with flat-to-2.5D geometry, deep navy, cyan, teal, blue, and restrained violet, crisp high-contrast edges, controlled bloom used only for active data flow, visually aligned with the presenter studio, no dense dashboard, no ornamental micro-details, no rendered words, no pseudo-text, and no spelling risk; camera_angle: Centered orthographic-to-shallow-perspective view facing the MCP hub head-on, with a symmetrical six-node layout, level horizon, and no extreme lens distortion; camera_movement: Begin in a centered full-screen composition, make one measured forward push toward the hub with only a subtle clockwise parallax arc during node activation, hold the complete system, then make one smooth straight pullback on the same axis and stop on the clean portal-sized composition against plain navy, with no abrupt cut, whip pan, camera roll, spatial discontinuity, corridor reveal, or environment change; sound_effects: Low warm technology ambience, one soft inbound pulse, six delicate activation ticks synchronized to the nodes, and one restrained completion shimmer, with no speech, vocals, loud bass hit, or distracting musical change.

evals.feedback: The second attempt preserves the six-node structure and plain navy environment, but it is materially worse because it generates multiple misspelled labels from the start, adds ornamental measurement marks, and pulls back far beyond the requested portal size. Reject this candidate. The final attempt should animate only existing reference shapes, treat repository terms as nonvisual metadata, create no new elements, and hold the unchanged textless composition.
evals.prompt_patch: subject: A textless cinematic motion graphic that preserves the supplied infographic reference exactly: one stable central cyan-and-teal server hub connected to exactly six stable circular icon nodes; the six existing icons conceptually map to the repository capabilities Messages, Rooms, Teams, Memberships, Webhooks, and ECM, but these names remain metadata only and never appear visually; use only the shapes already present in the supplied reference and create no new symbols, labels, interface panels, walls, controls, letters, words, numbers, captions, pseudo-code, logos, or watermarks; action: Begin on the supplied reference composition, send one cyan pulse into the central hub, illuminate each of the six existing outer icon nodes clockwise one at a time, hold all six active together, then reduce the complete unchanged composition smoothly to fifty-five percent of frame width and hold it against plain navy through the final frame; preserve the exact node count, icon shapes, connector topology, positions, colors, and background throughout, with no morphing, duplication, replacement, additional elements, text generation, or environment transformation; scene: One uninterrupted deep navy canvas with the supplied subtle grid and generous safe margins, containing only the central hub, six connected icon nodes, and restrained data glows; it remains a flat open navy field from first frame to last and never becomes a dashboard, room, tunnel, corridor, wall, door, screen, panel, or labeled diagram; style: Premium enterprise editorial motion design, flat-to-2.5D geometry, deep navy with cyan, teal, blue, and restrained violet, crisp high-contrast icon edges, controlled bloom only during activation, clean textless iconography, no ornamental micro-details, no glyph-like marks, and no spelling risk because no text exists; camera_angle: Centered head-on orthographic view of the supplied symmetrical six-node composition with level horizon and no perspective distortion; camera_movement: Make one restrained forward push of less than ten percent during activation, then one straight slow pullback that stops when the unchanged system occupies fifty-five percent of frame width, followed by a still hold through the end, with no orbit, cut, whip pan, camera roll, corridor reveal, excessive retreat, or spatial discontinuity; sound_effects: Low warm technology ambience, one soft inbound pulse, six delicate activation ticks, and one restrained completion shimmer, with no speech, vocals, loud bass hit, or musical change.
